cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this short video on what the Agent Framework Toolkit is.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支短片會介紹 Agent Framework Toolkit。

cues.en: Agent Framework Toolkit is something I, from time to time, mention in my various other videos, and I have made some dedicated videos about it before,
cues.zh: 我在其他影片中，不時會提到 Agent Framework Toolkit，之前也做過一些專門的介紹，

cues.en: but many people don't know what it is, so a small introduction here.
cues.zh: 不過很多人還不知道它是什麼，所以這裡做個簡短說明。

cues.en: So, Agent Framework Toolkit is, as you see on the screen, a set of three NuGet packages that sits on top of Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 如畫面所示，Agent Framework Toolkit 是三個建立在 Agent Framework 之上的 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: and adds various quality-of-life features.
cues.zh: 用來加入各種讓開發更方便的功能。

cues.en: So, the three main purposes is easier agent creation, easier tool creation, and out-of-the-box tools.
cues.zh: 三個主要目的，就是簡化代理程式建立、簡化工具建立，以及提供現成工具。

cues.en: This is for C Sharp only, so not for Python.
cues.zh: 它只支援 C#，不支援 Python。

cues.en: And the best way to explain what it is, is by giving a few examples.
cues.zh: 要解釋它的用途，最好的方式就是看看範例。

cues.en: So the first one is these easier agents, which is done using opinionated factories against the various providers, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and so on.
cues.zh: 首先是簡化代理程式，透過針對 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等供應商設計的 Factory 來建立。

cues.en: And, as an example, if we want to make an agent for plain vanilla Agent Framework
cues.zh: 例如，若直接使用原版 Agent Framework，

cues.en: using Azure OpenAI with a GPT-5 Mini, with low reasoning effort and tool calling middleware, we would need to write something like this.
cues.zh: 透過 Azure OpenAI 使用 GPT-5 mini，設定低推理強度與工具呼叫中介軟體，就必須寫成這樣。

cues.en: We would need to make our client, we would need to make our agent, and inside our agent we need to set some extra things in order to set the low reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 先建立用戶端與代理程式，再到代理程式選項的內層設定低推理強度。

cues.en: This is what's called breaking glass, because it's kind of a very, very low-level overriding object here.
cues.zh: 這通常稱為打破抽象層，也就是透過非常底層的物件覆寫設定。

cues.en: On top of that, in order to set our things, we need to put our tools inside the chat options when we want to do it here, so we can't place it like normal.
cues.zh: 此外，工具也必須放進 ChatOptions，不能像簡單版本那樣直接指定。

cues.en: And we need to use, as builder, use tool calling middleware.build in order to actually get the tool calling in there as well, because that's not set on here.
cues.zh: 而且還要呼叫 AsBuilder、加入工具呼叫中介軟體，再 Build，因為這裡沒有直接的選項。

cues.en: And the tool calling down here is the regular tool call, in which case, in this case, we're just printing out what tools we're calling.
cues.zh: 下方是一般的工具呼叫中介軟體；這個範例只印出目前呼叫了什麼工具。

cues.en: So this is the experience using the vanilla system.
cues.zh: 這就是使用原版框架的體驗。

cues.en: If you add the Agent Framework Toolkit on top, you would be able to do what you see on the screen with this code instead.
cues.zh: 如果加上 Agent Framework Toolkit，就能改成畫面上這段程式碼。

cues.en: So you would end up making an Azure OpenAI factory for agents, and you would make an Azure OpenAI agent.
cues.zh: 先建立 Azure OpenAI 的代理程式 Factory，再建立 Azure OpenAI Agent。

cues.en: Had it been Google, it would be a Google factory with a Google agent and so on.
cues.zh: 如果是 Google，就建立 Google Factory 與 Google Agent，其他供應商同理。

cues.en: And what I have done is I have made the configuration of each agent a flat structure.
cues.zh: 我把各代理程式的設定整理成扁平結構。

cues.en: There's nothing multi-level in any way.
cues.zh: 沒有多層巢狀設定。

cues.en: Everything has been put down, so it's very, very easy to do.
cues.zh: 所有設定都放在同一層，因此容易使用。

cues.en: So, for example, reasoning effort is directly on some agent options.
cues.zh: 例如可以直接在代理程式選項上指定推理強度。

cues.en: Tools is directly there, and a special raw tool called Details is there to take care of middleware in just a read manner.
cues.zh: Tools 也直接放在這裡，另外有 RawToolCallDetails，可以用唯讀方式觀察工具呼叫，不必自行建立中介軟體。

cues.en: So much less code and much easier code to understand because it's just a flat model.
cues.zh: 因此程式碼更少，也因為是扁平模型而更容易理解。

cues.en: And this is supported by all the major providers.
cues.zh: 所有主要供應商都支援這種方式。

cues.en: So, for example, here is Antropics Cloud.
cues.zh: 例如這裡是 Anthropic 的 Claude。

cues.en: We can do exactly the same.
cues.zh: 同樣可以用完全相同的方式。

cues.en: It's just called an Antropic Agent Factory with an Antropic Agent coming back.
cues.zh: 只是建立的是 AnthropicAgentFactory，回傳 AnthropicAgent。

cues.en: And in here, we have specific Antropic Agent options because in Antropic, the max output tokens is a mandatory field.
cues.zh: 這裡有 Anthropic 專屬選項，因為它要求一定要設定 MaxOutputTokens。

cues.en: So this one ensures that you remember to set it.
cues.zh: 這個設計能確保你記得提供。

cues.en: And it, of course, supports their breaking glass features like budget tokens and so on.
cues.zh: 當然也支援供應商原生選項，例如 BudgetTokens。

cues.en: In the same manner, Google, you just make a Google agent or an AI agent, as you can see here.
cues.zh: Google 同樣可以建立 GoogleAgent，或直接用 AIAgent，如畫面所示。

cues.en: More about that later.
cues.zh: 稍後再說明這一點。

cues.en: And you can set, for example, their thinking level.
cues.zh: 也可以設定它的 ThinkingLevel。

cues.en: And down here, you can see all the different providers that I support at the moment.
cues.zh: 下方列出目前支援的各種供應商。

cues.en: So it should be fairly simple, and if you need one more provider, it's very easy to extend these.
cues.zh: 用法應該相當簡單；如果還需要其他供應商，也很容易擴充。

cues.en: But you might think, okay, if we're going opinionated, it might not be able to do everything that Agent Framework can do.
cues.zh: 你可能會想，這種有明確設計取向的封裝，是否無法支援 Agent Framework 的全部功能？

cues.en: And that's not the case.
cues.zh: 其實不是。

cues.en: There's no limitations despite being opinionated.
cues.zh: 即使有自己的使用方式，也沒有因此限制功能。

cues.en: So on the connection side, we can still use credentials instead of API keys.
cues.zh: 連線方面，仍能使用憑證而不是 API 金鑰。

cues.en: We can still go to responses API.
cues.zh: 也能選用 Responses API。

cues.en: We can still set network timeouts.
cues.zh: 仍然可以設定網路逾時。

cues.en: Or if anything special you do, there's always a hook-in to the additional underlying options.
cues.zh: 如果需要特殊設定，也一直保留存取底層額外選項的入口。

cues.en: And on the agent side, you don't need to make it a Google agent or an OpenAI agent.
cues.zh: 代理程式方面，不一定非得使用 GoogleAgent 或 OpenAIAgent 型別。

cues.en: It's just a wrapper around AI agents.
cues.zh: 它們只是 AIAgent 的包裝。

cues.en: So if you need all the agents to be in AI agents to pass around to the rest of Agent Framework, you can do that.
cues.zh: 如果要用 AIAgent 傳給 Agent Framework 其他部分，也完全可以。

cues.en: And it supports all the options.
cues.zh: 而且支援所有選項。

cues.en: All the common options like instructions, models, tools, less options like ID, max description, temperature, all the different providers and factories.
cues.zh: 包含常用的指示、模型、工具，較少用的 ID、名稱、描述、Temperature，以及各種提供者與工廠。

cues.en: So AI context providers can be set, the chat history can be set, client factory and logging factory, and the services as well.
cues.zh: 因此可以設定 AI Context Provider、對話歷程、ClientFactory、LoggerFactory，以及 Services。

cues.en: We can support all the middleware, but it's been put into being properties on the options instead of down as builder,
cues.zh: 也支援全部中介軟體，只是改成選項物件的屬性，不必再串 AsBuilder，

cues.en: so it's easier to work with.
cues.zh: 因此使用起來比較方便。

cues.en: And then there's, of course, the OpenAI-specific features like client type, reasoning effort, reasoning summary, service tier, and so on.
cues.zh: 當然，還有 OpenAI 專屬功能，例如用戶端類型、推理強度、推理摘要與 ServiceTier。

cues.en: And finally, I put in a bunch of debugging features, so you can, with one line here,
cues.zh: 最後，我加入了一些除錯功能，只要一行程式碼，

cues.en: add the raw HTTP tool client, so you can begin to see the raw JSONs being sent
cues.zh: 就能加入原始 HTTP 用戶端記錄，查看實際送出的 JSON，

cues.en: to the LLM and from the LLM.
cues.zh: 以及 LLM 回傳的 JSON。

cues.en: And if, again, there's anything I'm missing, there's an option to provide extra things for chat client agent options.
cues.zh: 如果仍有漏掉的設定，也能額外提供 ChatClientAgentOptions。

cues.en: So, again, no limitations at all.
cues.zh: 所以再次強調，沒有功能限制。

cues.en: Similarly, we also have our tool factory, which makes tools easier to create.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也有工具 Factory，讓建立工具更加容易。

cues.en: So, this reintroduces something that Semantic Kernel had in that we can add attributes onto our classes
cues.zh: 它重新帶回 Semantic Kernel 曾經有過的做法，在類別，

cues.en: and the various methods we want with an AI tool attribute, where we give the tool name and the description.
cues.zh: 以及指定的方法上加入 AITool 屬性，提供工具名稱與描述。

cues.en: And if we do that, we can simply use this AI tools factory to, say, get tools from the raw class or the instance if you want to.
cues.zh: 接著就能用 AIToolsFactory，直接從類別型別或執行個體取得工具。

cues.en: You can, of course, do this with normal reflection.
cues.zh: 當然，你也可以自己用反射完成。

cues.en: I've just done the reflection part for you.
cues.zh: 我只是替你寫好了反射的部分。

cues.en: Similar, it has hooks into MCP servers, so the factory can just turn
cues.zh: 同樣也提供 MCP 伺服器整合，Factory 可以直接，

cues.en: an MCP remote from just a URL into tools.
cues.zh: 根據遠端 MCP 的網址取得工具。

cues.en: You can, of course, specify header properties and so on if need be.
cues.zh: 需要時也能設定標頭等額外資訊。

cues.en: And then there's local MCP servers that is also supported.
cues.zh: 另外也支援本機 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: Finally, I have my own implementation of agent skills that came a little before agent framework put it in.
cues.zh: 最後，我也有自己的 Agent Skills 實作，比 Agent Framework 官方加入得稍早。

cues.en: And it has its variety.
cues.zh: 它的做法略有不同。

cues.en: It turns it into tools instead of using the AI context provider.
cues.zh: 會把技能轉成工具，而不是使用 AI Context Provider。

cues.en: Besides being able to take your own tools and define them easily, I also put in a set of common out-of-the-box tools.
cues.zh: 除了簡化自己的工具定義之外，我也提供了一組常用的現成工具。

cues.en: So, there's time tools, so you can tell your agent exactly what the time of day it is, either in UTC or in local time.
cues.zh: 例如時間工具，可以讓代理程式知道現在的 UTC 或本機時間。

cues.en: There's integration into some weather tools for real open weather map.
cues.zh: 還有透過 OpenWeatherMap 查詢真實天氣的工具。

cues.en: You just need a read API key from them, and then you have full access to weather around the world.
cues.zh: 只要取得他們的讀取 API 金鑰，就能存取全球天氣資料。

cues.en: There's file system tools, so you can create and get files and folders on the system.
cues.zh: 另外有檔案系統工具，可以建立、取得檔案與資料夾。

cues.en: And there's guardrails built into them, so you can set what exactly they are allowed to use, of which folders and so on.
cues.zh: 也內建存取限制，能指定允許使用哪些資料夾等範圍。

cues.en: And by the way, these tools are completely out of the box, but you need to define if you want to use them.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這些工具雖然現成可用，但仍必須由你明確決定是否使用。

cues.en: It's not like if you use agent framework tool kit that you suddenly get full access to your file systems.
cues.zh: 不是安裝 Agent Framework Toolkit，就突然讓代理程式擁有整個檔案系統的存取權。

cues.en: That's on your definition of if you want to use them or not.
cues.zh: 要不要提供那些工具，仍由你決定。

cues.en: There's website tools for getting content off a page, screen-scraping.
cues.zh: 還有網站工具，可以擷取網頁內容。

cues.en: There's HTTP client tools, so you can actually call APIs and stuff like that, if you desire to do so, and it can, again,
cues.zh: 以及 HTTP 用戶端工具，必要時能讓代理程式呼叫 API，同樣可以，

cues.en: have guardrails in on what different endpoints you are allowed to use.
cues.zh: 設定允許使用的端點範圍。

cues.en: And finally, there's a little email tool where you can send SMTP emails.
cues.zh: 最後是一個簡單的電子郵件工具，可以透過 SMTP 寄信。

cues.en: So just tools that you sometimes need and don't want to write yourself.
cues.zh: 這些都是偶爾會需要，但不想每次自己重寫的工具。

cues.en: So they have been written for you with lots of configuration options into every single tool.
cues.zh: 所以我把它們寫好，每個工具都提供許多設定選項。

cues.en: So that's everything. There is more.
cues.zh: 主要內容就是這些，其實還有其他功能。

cues.en: There's various quality-of-life extension methods and bedding factories, but we don't want to go into this.
cues.zh: 例如一些方便的擴充方法與嵌入模型 Factory，這裡就不深入。

cues.en: Instead, I want you to go in and check out the link.
cues.zh: 建議直接查看連結。

cues.en: It goes to the repo, which has a bunch of readmes about what every feature works and a wiki about it, and, of course, access to the NuGet packages
cues.zh: 連結會前往儲存庫，裡面有各功能的 README 與 Wiki，當然也能找到 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: that you can get for free and just put on top with no limitations.
cues.zh: 免費安裝到原本框架上使用，而且沒有功能限制。

cues.en: So that's everything.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
